Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
**THE RECORD BREAKER**

FADE IN:

INT. WORLD RECORD OFFICE - DAY

We see a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and camera crews. At the center of it all is 127-year-old JASPER JENKINS, a frail but determined man with a twinkle in his eye. He is escorted to a podium, where a plaque awaits him.

OFFICIAL
Ladies And Gentlemen, It Is Our Pleasure To Present The World Record For Oldest Human To Ever Live, Held By The Incomparable Jasper Jenkins!

Jasper Steps Up To The Podium, A Beaming Smile On His Face. The Crowd Erupts In Cheers And Applause As He Accepts The Plaque.

CUT TO:

INT. JASPER'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

Jasper Lies In Bed, The Plaque From Earlier Displayed On His Nightstand. He Looks Up At The Ceiling, A Faraway Look In His Eyes.

JASPER (V.O)
I Remember Reading About This Theory Online, Back In The Day. Quantum Immortality. It Said That If You Were Born In A Multiverse, And Every Time You Died, You Got Reborn In A Parallel Universe, Then You Would Eventually Live Forever.

Jasper's Eyes Glaze Over As He Becomes Lost In Thought.

JASPER (V.O) (CONT'D)
It Made Sense, At The Time. I Meant, If I Was Born In A Multiverse, And Every Time I Died, I Got Reborn, Then I Would Eventually Live Forever. No Limits, No Bounds.

Jasper's Voice Becomes More Frenzied, His Words Slipping Into Incoherence.

JASPER (V.O) (CONT'D)
BUT WHAT IF IT'S NOT JUST A THEORY? WHAT IF IT'S REAL? WHAT IF I'M NOT JUST LIVING IN ONE UNIVERSE, BUT IN ALL OF THEM?

Jasper's Body Begins To Shake, His Eyes Rolling Back In His Head. He Starts To Crawl Out Of Bed, His Hands Reaching Out Like Tentacles.

JASPER (V.O) (CONT'D)
I HAVE TO FIND THEM ALL. I HAVE TO FIND ALL THE PARALLEL UNIVERSES. I HAVE TO LIVE FOREVER.

The Camera Zooms In On Jasper's Face, His Eyes Wild And Unhinged.

JASPER (V.O) (CONT'D)
I WILL NOT REST. I WILL NOT SLEEP. I WILL FIND THEM ALL.

The Screen Fades To Black As Jasper's Maniacal Laughter Echoes Through The Room.

FADE OUT.
